attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file New Mexico state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NM Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get apportionment.state_code get 'NM' eq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get apportionment.state_code get 'NM' eq and

action_details.action_postfix:
# NM filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). # # A corporation has physical presence nexus in NM if it has: # - An office, store, warehouse, or other place of business in NM # - Employees working in NM # - Tangible personal property located in NM # - Real property located in NM # # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-4-2 (Nexus standards) # Reference: NM Taxation and Revenue Department Publication FYI-350
"NM filing required - physical nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

# NM filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). # # Economic nexus threshold: $100,000 gross receipts in NM. # # New Mexico simplified its economic nexus requirements by eliminating # the transaction count threshold. Only the gross receipts threshold # ($100,000) applies. # # Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), NM requires # filing if a corporation exceeds economic nexus threshold, even without # physical presence. # # Measurement: Prior year sales determine nexus (2024 sales determine 2025 nexus). # # Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) # Reference: NM Taxation and Revenue Department Economic Nexus Guidance # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-9-3.5 (Economic nexus provisions)
"NM filing required - economic nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

# No NM nexus - no filing requirement. # # Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. # Any estimated payments would be refunded. # # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-4-2 (Nexus requirements)
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NM - no nexus, no filing required" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NM state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Includes adjustments for NM's decoupling from federal bonus depreciation, IRC 168(n), and IRC 163(j) provisions.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NM Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NM state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix:
# NM state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. # # NM ADDITIONS to federal taxable income include: # - Interest income from U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to NM) # - Bonus depreciation addback - NM decouples from IRC § 168(k) # (100% bonus depreciation for qualified property placed in service after 1/19/2025) # - IRC § 168(n) qualified production property expensing addback # (100% expensing provision - effective for tax years beginning on or after 1/1/2027) # - IRC § 163(j) business interest deduction adjustments # (NM decouples from federal interest deduction changes) # - State income taxes deducted on federal return # - Expenses related to exempt income # # NM SUBTRACTIONS from federal taxable income include: # - Interest on NM state and municipal bonds # - NM net operating loss deduction (subject to NM limitations) # - Dividend income eligible for NM dividend received deduction (85%) # - Certain refunds of state income taxes # # SIGNIFICANT 2025 REFORM: # Senate Bill 151 (2025) represents one of the most significant corporate # tax reforms of the year. NM decoupled from federal provisions to prevent # erosion of the corporate tax base and corporate tax avoidance. # # Decoupling provisions: # - IRC § 168(k) bonus depreciation: Addback required # - IRC § 168(n) qualified property: Addback required (effective 2027) # - IRC § 163(j) business interest: Adjustment required # # Reference: NM Form CIT-1 Schedule A (Additions to Federal Taxable Income) # Reference: NM Form CIT-1 Schedule B (Deductions from Federal Taxable Income) # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-2A-8 (Adjustments to federal taxable income) # Reference: Senate Bill 151 (2025 corporate tax reform)
0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"NM income adjustments calculated" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"NM - no nexus, no adjustments" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NM state corporate income tax. Applies NM 5.9% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. NM changed to flat rate system in 2025 (previously had graduated rates).

initial_action.action_postfix: "NM State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NM tax at 5.9% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix:
# NM state corporate income tax calculation: # # 1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] # 2. Apportioned to NM: × [NM apportionment percentage] # 3. NM additions: + [Federal interest, bonus depreciation, IRC 168(n), IRC 163(j), etc.] # 4. NM subtractions: - [NM municipal interest, NM NOL, dividend deductions, etc.] # 5. NM taxable income: = [Result] # 6. NM tax rate: × 5.9% (FLAT RATE - effective 2025) # 7. NM income tax: = [Tax before credits] # 8. NM credits: - [Job creation, rural area, technology jobs, film, renewable energy, etc.] # 9. NM tax liability: = [Final tax] # # NM uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor). # # NM tax rate history: # - 2025+: 5.9% flat rate (simplified from graduated rates) # - Before 2025: Graduated rates (4.8% to 5.9% depending on income level) # # The 2025 change to a flat 5.9% rate represents a relatively rare case # of a corporate income tax rate INCREASE in recent years, as NM moved # from graduated rates (starting at 4.8%) to a flat 5.9% on all income. # # NM provides various tax credits including: # - Job training incentive program credit # - Rural job tax credit # - Technology jobs and research and development tax credit # - Film production tax credit # - Renewable energy production tax credit # - Sustainable building tax credit # # Reference: NM Form CIT-1 (Corporate Income and Franchise Tax Return) # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-2A-5 (Tax rate of 5.9% flat rate - effective 2025) # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-4-10 (Single-sales apportionment) # Reference: NM Taxation and Revenue Department Corporate Tax Guidance 2025 # Reference: Senate Bill 151 (2025 corporate tax reform)
apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.nm_state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NM tax calculated: $" apportionment.state_tax get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

# No NM taxable income - no tax liability. # # Corporation has NM nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment # and adjustments. Any estimated payments are refunded. # # NM net operating loss (NOL) rules: # - NM allows NOL carryforward for 20 years # - No carryback allowed (as of 2025) # - NOL limited to prevent complete elimination of tax liability # # Reference: NM Form CIT-1 (Corporate Income and Franchise Tax Return) # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-2A-8 (Net operating loss deduction)
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NM - nexus but no taxable income" job.audit_trail swap addto

# No NM nexus - no tax liability. # # Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in NM. # Any estimated payments are refunded. # # Reference: New Mexico Statutes § 7-4-2 (Nexus requirements)
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NM - no nexus, no tax liability" job.audit_trail swap addto
